name: tia-portal-mcp-read
description: Explore TIA Portal projects, PLC code, hardware and public API schemas with an AI assistant.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to local TIA Portal through a fixed Read broker and exact-version workers. Includes project/device/PLC browsing, tag and constant queries, native cross-references where supported, hardware inspection and public API type/property/service discovery. Mutation and native content-export tools are absent. Siemens runtime DLLs are not bundled. V20 is experimental and runtime-unverified.

tia_version.title: TIA Portal version
tia_version.description: Use auto when exactly one supported TIA version is installed and its worker is included in this bundle, or enter a bundled version explicitly. Auto considers all installed V17 to V20 versions, including versions omitted from a development subset build. V20 is experimental and runtime-unverified.
